description: Live bug (modeled on the real case: checking 'Starship's Mage' by Glynn Stewart pulled in 'Interstellar Mage', 'Mage-Provocateur', and 'Agents of Mars' -- all real Glynn Stewart books, but from 'Starship's Mage: Red Falcon', an entirely separate 3-book spin-off series that just shares the same 'Starship's Mage Universe' branding). Each spin-off subtitle literally says 'A <Flagship Series> Universe Novel', so the flagship series name was textually present as a substring/token match -- but that's a spin-off marker, not proof of membership in the flagship series being checked, and none of the spin-off titles had a series-position number tying them to it either. The downgrade should only kick in when there is no other evidence tying the book to the series being checked -- a same-batch spin-off-labeled title that the provider tags with a real series-position number for the series being checked must still be accepted. Frozen from tests/test_series_discovery.py::SeriesCheckIntegrationTest::test_universe_tie_in_spinoff_series_is_not_pulled_into_flagship_series and ::test_universe_tie_in_is_still_accepted_with_a_real_series_position_number (test data uses the stand-in series name 'Cherry Blossom Girls' / author 'Harmon Cooper', as frozen in the live test suite, rather than the real-world 'Starship's Mage' names the bug was found under).

candidates.title: Interstellar Mage: A Cherry Blossom Girls Universe Novel
Mage-Provocateur: A Cherry Blossom Girls Universe Novel
Some Companion Tale: A Cherry Blossom Girls Universe Novel
